recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中散布大量核偏心、染色質呈車輪狀、核旁有淡染區（perinuclear hof）且細胞質深藍的漿細胞，並夾雜較大、核仁明顯的未成熟漿細胞，其餘為顆粒球與紅血球系；漿細胞明顯增多符合多發性骨髓瘤復發。
features: Increased plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse clock-face chromatin and perinuclear hof
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm; some larger immature plasma cells with finer chromatin and nucleoli
Admixed maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors and a mitotic figure (top center)
Fat vacuoles at the edges; background otherwise cellular
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular and shows a conspicuous increase in plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clumped chromatin, perinuclear clearing and deeply basophilic cytoplasm. A subset are larger with finer chromatin and visible nucleoli, consistent with immature plasma cells. Residual granulocytic and erythroid precursors are present, along with a mitotic figure. In a patient with known plasma cell myeloma, findings are consistent with relapsed multiple myeloma; a plasma cell differential count and confirmation of clonality by flow cytometry or kappa/lambda staining are recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells are mature, usually fewer than 10%, often perivascular, and polytypic for kappa and lambda.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with MYD88 L265P rather than a pure plasma cell population.
Early erythroblasts have round central nuclei and deep blue cytoplasm without a perinuclear hof or eccentric nucleus.
